# Select

Takes the value of one field from each element of an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Select(items, fieldName)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to read. Null is read as an empty array. Any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |
| `fieldName` | string | The name of the field to take, one key as written: a name with a dot in it is never read as a path. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |

## Returns

Array. A new array with one element for each element of items, in order: the value of the field, or null when the element is not an object or has no such field. Never null itself.

## Example

`Select([{ "name": "a" }, { "id": 2 }, 5], "name")` returns `["a", null, null]`.
